title: Alcaraz Wins ATP Stella Perfect Serve of the Year Vote
text:
Alcaraz Serves Up Stella Artois Perfect Serve of teh Year Award
A fan vote has crowned Carlos Alcaraz’s performance in cincinnati as the Stella Artois Perfect Serve of the Year, recognizing the standout moment from the 2025 ATP Tour season.The Spanish tennis star edged out fellow contenders Jannik Sinner and Taylor Fritz in the popular vote,celebrating the best serves of the year.
A Cincinnati Masterclass
The award, presented by Stella Artois, acknowledges Alcaraz’s brilliance during the semifinal match of the Cincinnati Open against alexander Zverev. the decisive moment came as Alcaraz unleashed three consecutive aces early in the match,demonstrating his dominance and securing the honor.
while Alcaraz took home the top prize, other players delivered exceptional serving performances throughout the 2025 season.Taylor Fritz showcased remarkable consistency at the ATP 250 in Stuttgart, remaining undefeated in 43 service games. He also registered an remarkable 45 aces while facing only four break points, solidifying his position as a serving powerhouse.
Jannik Sinner also proved his mettle, successfully defending his title at the prestigious Nitto ATP Finals in Turin.According to Infosys ATP Stats, Sinner saved an astounding 14 of the 15 break points he faced, highlighting his resilience and skill under pressure.
Fan Engagement and Stella Artois Partnership
The stella Artois Award provides a unique chance for tennis fans to participate in recognizing the sport’s most memorable moments. “The award offers fans the opportunity to vote for their favorite magical moments from the line,” a senior official stated.
Stella Artois, a leading premium beer brand, continues its strong partnership with the ATP tour as a Gold Partner and Official beer through 2028. This collaboration underscores the brand’s commitment to supporting and celebrating the world of professional tennis.
.
The Perfect Serve of the Year award highlights not only individual brilliance but also the passionate engagement of tennis fans worldwide, solidifying the ATP Tour’s position as a premier sporting event.
